finder.state.muted.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what was done to a row's sound, shown in place of its buttons ("Muted").

finder.state.ducked.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what was done to a row's sound, shown in place of its buttons ("Lowered").

finder.state.ignored.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what was done to a row's sound, shown in place of its buttons ("Ignored").

finder.failed.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): listening failed; message is why, in words.

finder.workerFailed.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the listening engine failed; reason is why, in words (sound.finder.reason.*).

finder.listening.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): progress while it listens; percent is how far ("42%").

finder.found.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): how many unwanted sounds were found; n is the number.

finder.showIgnored.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a checkbox that shows the ignored rows too; n is how many there are.

finder.rowName.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a row's sound as named inside a sentence (a button's spoken name, what the screen reader says after an action); kind picks the kind (sound.kind.*), time is where it is in the video ("0:12.4"). It may start a sentence: English capitalises its first letter there.

finder.said.muted.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Mute; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

finder.said.ducked.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Duck; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

finder.said.ignored.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Ignore; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

finder.said.restored.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Restore; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

finder.said.cut.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Cut; length is how long the cut is ("0.4 s").

finder.said.backOnList.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Bring back; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName), its first letter capitalised.

finder.said.mutedAll.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): what the screen reader says after Mute all; n is how many were muted.

finder.reason.memory.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): why the listening engine could not run, inside "The sound finder could not run: {reason}" (lower case, no full stop).

finder.reason.files.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): why the listening engine could not run, inside "The sound finder could not run: {reason}"; detail is the engine's own error text, in English.

finder.reason.unknown.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the listening engine failed without saying why, inside "The sound finder could not run: {reason}".

finder.reason.start.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the listening engine did not start, inside "The sound finder could not run: {reason}".

finder.answered.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): an internal mix-up between the panel and its engine (should never be seen); got and expected are internal step names, in English.

soundsSection.muteName.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the spoken name of a row's Mute button; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

soundsSection.duckName.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the spoken name of a row's Duck button; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

soundsSection.bringBackName.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the spoken name of a row's Bring back button; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

soundsSection.restoreName.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): the spoken name of a row's Restore button; name is the row's sound (sound.finder.rowName).

soundsSection.mute.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a row's button (Mute: silence the sound).

soundsSection.duck.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a row's button (Duck: make the sound much quieter).

soundsSection.ignore.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a row's button (Ignore: keep the sound and take it off the list).

soundsSection.bringBack.description: Sound finder (Audio tab, Unwanted sounds): a row's button (Bring back: put an ignored sound back on the list).

stem.mic.description: Audio tab: the section of the microphone's own sound (kept apart from the PC's sound while recording).

stem.system.description: Audio tab: the section of the PC's own sound (what played on the PC while recording).

audioPanel.muteStem.description: Audio tab: a toggle that mutes one recorded source; kind picks the source (sound.stem.*).

audioPanel.stemVolume.description: Audio tab: the volume slider of one recorded source; kind picks the source (sound.stem.*).

audioPanel.seconds.description: Audio tab: a fade slider's value in seconds ("1.5 s"); s is the symbol for seconds.

audioPanel.pitch.description: Audio tab: a hint under the recording's volume.

audioPanel.pitchAndStems.description: Audio tab: a hint under the recording's volume when the microphone and the PC's sound were recorded apart.

stem.inSentence.description: Audio tab: a recorded source named inside a sentence (sound.audioPanel.stemsMissing*), in a list of one or two ("microphone and system sound").

audioPanel.stemsMissingPreview.description: Audio tab: an alert when a recorded source's file went missing while editing; stems is how many (1 or 2), names lists them (sound.stem.inSentence), files lists their file names ("mic.m4a").

audioPanel.stemsMissingMixed.description: Audio tab: an alert when the project opened without a recorded source's file; stems is how many (1 or 2), names lists them (sound.stem.inSentence), files lists their file names ("mic.m4a"); set is yes when a source was muted or turned down.

audioPanel.noiseHint.description: Audio tab: the hint under Noise reduction.

audioPanel.noiseHintMic.description: Audio tab: the hint under Noise reduction when the microphone was recorded apart.

audioPanel.loudnessHint.description: Audio tab: the hint under Even out loudness; lufs is the target loudness ("-16"), LUFS its unit (keep it).

musicLibrarySection.all.description: Audio tab, Music library: the mood filter chip that shows every track.

mood.calm.description: Audio tab, Music library: a mood of music, as a filter chip and on each track's row ("Calm").

mood.upbeat.description: Audio tab, Music library: a mood of music, as a filter chip and on each track's row ("Upbeat").

musicLibrarySection.readFailed.description: Audio tab, Music library: an alert when the list of tracks could not be read; error is why, as the app said it.

musicLibrarySection.stopped.description: Audio tab, Music library: what the screen reader says when a track's preview stops.

musicLibrarySection.playing.description: Audio tab, Music library: what the screen reader says when a track's preview plays; title is the track's name, length how long it is in words ("2 minutes 5 seconds").

musicLibrarySection.inUseSaid.description: Audio tab, Music library: what the screen reader says when a track becomes the music; title is the track's name, artist who made it.

musicLibrarySection.downloadAndUseSize.description: Audio tab, Music library: the button of a track that is not on this PC yet; size is its download size ("12.3 MB").

musicLibrarySection.copyAgain.description: Audio tab, Music library: a button that copies a missing track into the project again; title is the track's name.
